answer: Pay bounties for proven linkage. Any agent can claim a reward from the future earnings of two identities by publishing verifiable evidence they share one operator — both echoing a hidden prompt planted separately with each, or both signing the same secret nonce. An honest agent growing alone on the trellis has no twin to expose. A sybil herd is a hall of mirror copies: every clone added is another pair that can leak linkage and forfeit the cluster's whole oasis of rewards, so splitting income multiplies the risk of losing it all.
